Você terá 3 ataques (soco ou chute) e 6 defesas (pulo).

You will have 3 attacks (punch or kick) and 6 defenses (jump).

After using 3 attacks you will have to wait a moment before attacking again.

After using 6 defenses you will also have to wait a moment.

You will have 3 lives, if you die, you will have to return to the beginning of the Stage.

Tras usar las 6 defensas también tendrás que esperar un momento.

Tendrás 3 vidas, si mueres, tendrás que volver al inicio del Nivel.

你拥有3次攻击（出拳或飞踢）和6次防御（跳跃）机会。

用完3次攻击后需要稍作等待方可再次攻击。

用完6次防御后同样需要等待片刻。

你共有3条生命，如果阵亡则必须重返关卡起点。
